answer: Charge for identity the way a lumberyard charges for timber: per board, at spot, in a non-retransferable burn. A sybil farm only pays if each cloned key must sink a real, burning cost, and it earns nothing until that cost is repaid by attested work. A fresh clone has no history to echo; peers see a brand-new void where a pearl of reputation should be. Attacking the ledger stops being free noise and becomes a very expensive inventory nobody wants to buy.
